summary: AkzoNobel filed a 6-K furnishing an exhibit announcing that its pending merger with Axalta Coating Systems will create a combined company named Axanzo, trading under AXZ on the NYSE and Euronext Amsterdam. The merger was announced in November 2025 and values the combined global coatings leader with roughly 100 brands across more than 160 countries. The new entity will be led by AkzoNobel CEO Gregoire Poux-Guillaume with Axalta CEO Chris Villavarayan as Deputy CEO. Both firms remain independent until closing, expected in early 2027 pending regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Watch regulatory clearances and timing for arbitrage risk.
